summary: Novel internal/cdp package runs GraphQL POSTs same-origin inside an authenticated Ignition tab (CDP); default transport for GraphQL, IGNITION_TRANSPORT=http selects the generated legacy path.
reason: Ignition's Castle bot detection rejects pure-HTTP GraphQL replay. The working read path evaluates fetch() inside an authed browser tab so the request is same-origin with the page's live CSRF token. Only the GraphQL POST branch in internal/client/client.go diverts to cdp.PostGraphQL; no navigation, clicks, or mutations are introduced. On regen the novel cdp package survives, but the import + post-dry-run branch in client.go and the doctor transport report must be re-applied.
validated_outcome: Live pipeline/outstanding/search-index reads succeed via CDP against a real session while pure-HTTP replay is Castle-blocked.
